title: Answer: time is a projection, and dark energy its damping toward static time

statements.text: A time projection operator carries time into the observed world. Dark energy is a time-damping metric tension, caused by the system's effort to synchronize with a static time at the fifteenth dimension.

sources.quote: which resolves Dark Energy as a time-damping metric tension caused by the system's geometric effort to synchronize with D15 Static Time
